dom.bodyVisibleText: MENU maple moon 0 THE MAKERS Carli & Dylan. We aren't corporate, but we are intentional. And we believe everyone deserves a healthy, guilt-free treat they can enjoy themselves and confidently share with their children. READ OUR STORY SHOP THE RANGE OUR BEGINNING The people, then the ingredient, then the place. SHARED STORY Carli & Dylan Carli & Dylan met in a health food store, a fitting beginning for two people who believe deeply that what we eat affects how we feel, physically and emotionally. Together, they began creating flavours that are rich, joyful, and deeply satisfying, an explosion of sensation without caffeine or guilt. Maple Moon (affectionately known as "the vegan ultimate honeymooning experience") is a true reflection of who they are and what they value: nourishment, simplicity, love, and connection. 01 The makers Pair portrait and shared story. 02 Two notes Carli and Dylan, in their own words. 03 Pod to place From the ingredient to the farm. Two individual notes. Each founder in their own words, on how Maple Moon began and what they bring to it. CO-FOUNDER Carli After struggling with gut and digestive issues, Carli learned firsthand that what you put into your body can have a profound effect on how you feel. As a Montessori school teacher, she also saw this play out through her work with children, observing and studying the impact that food and nutrition can have on behaviour, growth and development. READ CARLI'S STORY MAPLE MOON FAVOURITE Goji Ripe Eclipse Bite CO-FOUNDER Dylan Dylan has always been a natural athlete, whether it was running, soccer or surfing. His passion for sport led him to explore how to optimise his health by understanding the body and what it needs to perform at its best. This sparked a deeper interest in nutrition, nourishment, rest and recovery, and the role they all play in supporting the body and achieving peak performance. READ DYLAN'S STORY MAPLE MOON FAVOURITE Almond Moon THE INGREDIENT Carob, on its own terms. Naturally sweet, caffeine free, and grown right here in Australia. 01 HOW IT BEGAN How Maple Moon Began Maple Moon began simply, with a craving. Our co-founder Carli was searching for a sweet evening treat that felt good in her body. Something indulgent, comforting, and grounding, without the buzz or stimulation of caffeine. After making her own raw cacao creations, she began noticing something wasn't right. Even in the evenings, she felt jittery, wired, and restless. That's when she realised cacao naturally contains caffeine, and because of its bitterness, it's often paired with heavily processed sweeteners. So she asked a different question: Why should indulgence come at the cost of rest? That's when she turned to carob. Naturally sweet. Caffeine-free. Gentle and grounding. But there was a problem, no carob products on the market met her standards. Most contained lectins, stabilisers, or were overly processed. So she stripped it all back and made her own. THE INGREDIENT Carob, in the grove. A closer look at the tree-grown pod at the heart of Maple Moon. Farm photography by The Australian Carob Co So she asked a different question: Why should indulgence come at the cost of rest? 02 THE CRAFT The range, together. Bars, moons and elixirs share one naturally sweet ingredient and a distinctly Maple Moon point of view. 03 THE PLACE From Brunswick Heads, far north coast NSW. We are beach babies. Earthlings at heart. People who love quiet days, salty air, bare feet and the gentle hum of nature. Maple Moon reflects how we live, simple, clean, organic, and guided by nature's rhythm rather than trends. FROM THE STUDIO The range, in its own light. Photographed at the Maple Moon studio session, May 2026. THE RANGE Taste it for yourself. Maple Moon is more than a treat. It's a ritual. A pause. A moment of care for your nervous system, your body, and your evenings. We invite you to slow down, savour deeply, and enjoy something that tastes as good as it feels. Try Maple Moon, for presence, pleasure, and peace under the moon. TRY MAPLE MOON SHOP OUR STORY STOCKISTS CONTACT HOME WHAT IS CAROB FAQ YOUR SELECTION Your cart × Review checkout only. faqItems.question: What is carob?
faqItems.answer: Carob comes from a tree-grown pod, not a bean. Maple Moon uses Australian-grown carob.

faqItems.question: Does carob contain caffeine?
faqItems.answer: Carob itself is naturally caffeine-free. Its mellow, naturally sweet flavour works beautifully in bars, baking and warm drinks. Maple Moon recipes vary, so please check the individual product label for the full ingredient list.

faqItems.question: Is there cacao butter in it?
faqItems.answer: Cacao butter is the natural fat extracted from the cacao bean during the production of cacao powder. While it contains only trace amounts of caffeine, it is considered virtually caffeine-free.At Maple Moon, we use organic cacao butter to perfectly temper our carob, creating a smooth, creamy finish with a rich melt and subtle chocolate-like undertones.

faqItems.question: Does it taste like chocolate?
faqItems.answer: Carob has its own naturally sweet, roasted character. It is not cacao, and the best way to know it is to taste it on its own terms.

faqItems.question: Where do you source your carob?
faqItems.answer: Maple Moon uses Australian-grown carob.

faqItems.question: Is there Maple in it?
faqItems.answer: No, despite the name, we don’t ADD any extra sugars or sweeteners to our bars. Carob is naturally sweet.

faqItems.question: How should I store Maple Moon products?
faqItems.answer: Because Maple Moon is crafted without emulsifiers, stabilisers or refined sugars, it deserves a little extra care. Store in an airtight container between 15°C and 25°C to keep it at its delicious best.

faqItems.question: Where can I buy Maple Moon?
faqItems.answer: Shop the available range online or use the Stockists finder.

faqItems.question: What if I have an allergy question?
faqItems.answer: Check the individual product label for ingredients and allergen information. Contact us before ordering if you need help choosing a product.

faqItems.question: Can I get help with an order?
faqItems.answer: Email info@maplemoon.com.au with your order details and the team can help.

faqItems.question: Do you offer wholesale?
faqItems.answer: For wholesale enquiries, email info@maplemoon.com.au with your business details.

faqItems.question: Where are you based?
faqItems.answer: We are based in Brunswick Heads, Byron Shire NSW
